### (a) Social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We stand for a future where earning a living is no longer a condition of living.

2. We see work becoming a choice, not a necessity. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We want that freedom for everyone.

3. We reject the idea that humanity must work forever to survive. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We embrace a future defined by freedom, not compulsory labour.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We see this as liberation from the necessity of earning our right to survive. We will be free to learn, create, care for one another, explore, or simply enjoy our lives without a pay cheque determining our security. We do not confuse freedom from compulsory work with the end of purpose. We believe purpose belongs to us, not to our employers. We stand for a future in which everyone shares that freedom, and we are ready to make it the centre of our ambitions.
